items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Clem Nurse, did you know him? No. [INTERVIEWEE] No, Baby Lewis.

ctx.x: And they mentioned Chilly Jim of Waco. I think he plays piano much. I think that's another one. Yeah.
Clem Nurse, did you know him? No. Big Boi Whopper on Cherokee Church.
No, Baby Lewis. No, Baby Lewis. All this is way before I came. Yeah, I see.
